meta.title: Anagraw d Tmetti n Qarṭaǧ
meta.desc: Isufiten, Asqamu, Imeqqranen n 104, Tajmaɛt n Ugdud : amek i tḥekkem Qarṭaǧ, ayen i d-yeqqaṛ Aristote fell-as, akked wid i d-isekkawen tametti tapunikt.
hero.title: Tasertit d Tmetti di Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: Ulac agellid ulac tiran : tagduda n yimettjaren, yettwaɛzen sɣur Aristote, anda sin ineɣlafen i d-ttwafernen, Asqamu d Tajmaɛt n Ugdud bḍan adabu.
hero.alt: Lebqayed n lḥara tapunikt ɣef taɣalt n Byrsa, Qarṭaǧ
hero.caption: Lḥara tapunikt n Byrsa, yebna di tazwara n lqern wis 2 uq.Ɛ.
stats.0.t: n isufiten i d-ttwafernen i useggas — « igelliden » n yimeskaren igrikiyen d yilatiniyen
stats.1.t: n yiɛessasen n wesqamu n uɛraḍ akken i d-yeqqaṛ Aristote (« Imeqqranen » ɣer Justin)
stats.2.t: d lweqt n twuri i yiɛessasen-agi deffir tririt n Hannibal di 196 — zdat-s armi d tamettant (Tite-Live)
stats.3.t: n tiran ulac yerna ulac tagrawla ara nebder deg umezruy n temdint, akken i d-yeqqaṛ Aristote
schema.title: Anwa i yḥekkmen Qarṭaǧ ?
schema.aside: Anagraw i d-qqaṛen Imezwura « amxallaṭ » : kra n tgelda, aṭas n yimeqqranen, amur n tdimukrasit.
schema.aria: Askasi n wanagraw n Qarṭaǧ akked yizdayen-nsen
schema.note: Izirig yettwaṛẓen : azday ur yettwassen ara. Askasi-agi isdukkel addad aneggaru (lqern wis 4–3) seg tɣbula idrisen aktar d tigrikiyen.
organs.0.d: Seg wawal afiniqi shofet, « amɛeṣṣef ». Sin ineɣlafen ttwafernen yal aseggas, Igrigen d Iṛumaniyen semman-ten « igelliden » ulac awal nniḍen. Ssawalen Asqamu, feṣlen lḥeqq, ḥekkmen tamdint, maca ur ḥekkmen ara lɛesker. Ur yettwassen ara anwa i ten-yefernen : imeqqranen neɣ ugdud.
organs.0.src: Sznycer ; Sénèque, Talwit n Teɣẓin, IV, 5
organs.1.d: Tirawin ssawalent-d « Imɣaren n Qarṭaǧ ». Yusa-d seg twaculin timeqqranin, yesɛa ahat aṭas n imeqqranen deg-s. Amennuɣ, talwit, tadiblumasit : nețța i yettwasbedden deg tɣawsiwin timeqqranin, yerna iqayden n lɛesker ttasen-d ad as-rren lexbar.
organs.2.d: Asqamu amecṭuḥ i t-isemman akka Aristote kan (« Imeqqranen n 104 » neɣ « Imeqqranen »). Akken i d-yeqqaṛ Justin, meyya n yiɛessasen i d-ittwafernen seg Usqamu țɛerḍen tigawt n yiqayden asmi d-uɣalen. Ttwafernen i tudert meṛṛa armi d tririt n Hannibal.
organs.3.d: Tiǧmuyaɛ n xemsa imdanen, i d-ihedren fell-asent Aristote kan. Ferrnent iman-nsent, xeddment ɣef tɣawsiwin timeqqranin, ferrnent imdanen n Imeqqranen n 104. Tawuri-nsent s telqayt mazal-itt d tabaḥart.
organs.4.d: Irgazen ilelliyen, ddukklen deg agora akken i d-yeqqaṛ Diodore. Mi ur myefhamen ara isufiten d Usqamu, tamsalt tettawi-tt-id tajmaɛt, yal yiwen izmer ad yagi i tuttra (Aristote). Polybe iḥesb belli tṭṭef adabu aktar deg lweqt n yimenɣan ipunikiyen.
organs.5.d: Aḥekkam n lɛesker yebḍa ɣef tneɣlafin tiɣersiwin. Iqayden, ttwafernen seg twaculin timeqqranin, ttwafernen ɣer tama, ahat sɣur tajmaɛt. Rrant lexbar i Usqamu, yezmer Imeqqranen n 104 a ten-ɛerḍen deffir umennuɣ.
aristo.title: Ddustur yettwabedren d lemtel
aristo.quote: « Qarṭaǧ tettwassen s uḥekkam igerrzen […]. Abeggen n ddustur iqam : ugdud yeqqim yeddukel akked unagraw, ur d-nwala ara dinna tagrawla iwulmen n yisem-is, ulac tiran. »
aristo.cite: Aristote, Tasertit, II, 11 (ca. 330 uq.Ɛ.) — asuqel ilelli
aristo.text: Aristote yessers Qarṭaǧ, d tamdint-nni kan ur nelli ara tagrikit, ɣer tama n Sparte d Crète gar ddusturen ifazen aktar : anagraw « amxallaṭ » i yesdukklen tagelda (isufiten), imeqqranen (Asqamu) akked tdimukrasit (tajmaɛt). Polybe daɣen ad d-yebder lqima n wanagraw-agi (VI, 43).
aristo.debate: D tewlaft n yiwen wass, mačči d lemtel ur nbeddel : lqima n tira-agi tettwamyaɣ fell-as seg Stéphane Gsell, yerna imezruyen n wass-a qeblen belli anagraw-agi ibeddel seg lqern ɣer lqern (Sznycer).
critics.title: Aṭas n wazal i ssɛaya
critics.items.0: Ferrnen ineɣlafen ɣef ssɛaya-nsen am wakken ɣef lqima-nsen : d adabu n yimeqqranen.
critics.items.1: Tineɣlafin ɛlayen ttwasnezzent — win ixedmen ad inadi syen ad issɛaya.
critics.items.2: Yiwen wergaz yezmer ad yesɛu aṭas n tneɣlafin deg yiwet n tikkelt.
critics.items.3: Talwit n temdint teqqen ɣer ssɛaya : Qarṭaǧ tazen yal tikkelt amur n ugdud ad ssɛayan deg temdinin i tḥekkem.
critics.polybe: Sin iqernan deffir-s, Polybe iḥesb belli ddustur n Qarṭaǧ yekker ad yeɣli : deg lweqt n Hannibal, ugdud yeṭṭef adabu asmi di Ṛuma Asqamu mazal iḥekkem (VI, 51). Yebder-d daɣen belli di Qarṭaǧ tneɣlafin ttwasnezzent s wudem azzayez, asmi di Ṛuma win yesnezzen tefrant ad yemmet (VI, 56).
evo.kick: Seg lqern wis 8 armi d zzman aṛumi
evo.title: Anagraw i Yettbeddilen
evo.link: Hannibal, seg umennuɣ armi d tsufeta →
evo.rows.0.v: Didon d taderrawt n ugellid, maca tamacahutt werǧin tt-id-tsemma d tagellidt. « Igelliden » n tira tigrikiyen d tilatiniyen, s tidet, d isufiten. Lexyal n tgelda n Qarṭaǧ, i yesbedden K. J. Beloch syen G. Charles-Picard, yettwagi ass-a sɣur aṭas n yimezruyen ; ula di Tyr, igelliden ur sɛin ara adabu ačaɛal (Sznycer).
evo.rows.1.v: Deg waṭas n tsutiwin, arraw n yiwen Magon fkan i temdint iqayden n umennuɣ-nsen (Justin, XVIII–XIX). D asali n twacult ugar n tgelda ; yiwen seg-sen, Hamilcar, yettwanneɣ di Himère di 480.
evo.rows.2.v: Akken twacult n yiqayden ur tḥerrez ara talelli, yettwaxleq usqamu n meyya n yiɛessasen ttwafernen seg yimɣaren : iqayden ilaq ad as-rren lexbar asmi d-uɣalen (Justin, XIX, 2). D ahat lsas n Imeqqranen n 104 n Aristote.
evo.rows.3.v: D annect-agi i d-yeḥka Aristote. Wid i yeqsed adabu i yiman-nsen ur rebḥen ara : di 308, deg tɛeddawt n Agathocle, aqayed Bomilcar issay ad yeṭṭef tamdint s ddem ; yettwanneɣ yettwanɣa.
evo.rows.4.v: Snat tsertiyin i d-mgaraden : Hannon, ameslay n wid yesɛan lqaɛa tameqqrant, yeqqim ɣef lexla n Tefriqt yennuɣ mgal imenɣan n At Barca ; nutni ṭṭfen ɣef Spania d laḥya n ugdud (Polybe). Lexyal n At Barca i yettargun tagelda tagrikit yettwagi sɣur M. Sznycer.
evo.rows.5.v: Deffir Zama, Hannibal yettwafren d asufet. Isseɣli aneɣlaf n yidrimen i t-yagin, isserseg ad ttwafernen iɛessasen n Imeqqranen n 104, zik armi d tamettant, i useggas kan war ma țɛawaden-t aseggas i d-iteddun, syen inadi ɣef wayen yettwakksen : lexraj i Ṛuma yezmer ad yettwaxelles war lexraj amaynut (Tite-Live, XXXIII, 46-47). Yettwasbeggen i Ṛuma sɣur yiɛdawen-is, yeffeɣ ɣer berra di 195.
evo.rows.6.v: Qarṭaǧ teṛwa, mačči anagraw-is : temdinin n Tefriqt taṛumit mazal ferrnent isufiten armi d lqern wis 2 dffr Ɛ., kra n tikkal tlata deg umkan n sin — amur amaziɣ akken i d-qqaṛen kra n yimassanen (Lipinski).
society.title: Tametti Tḥuza Aṭas Idrisen
society.aside: Deg wenẓul, imeqqranen n uẓar n Tyr ; ddaw-s, ugdud i d-ǧǧan tira almi d yal tikkelt deg tillas.
society.groups.0.d: Arraw n yimezdaɣen n Tyr, twaculin-agi timeqqranin ṭṭfent tadamsa, tasertit d ddin. Zik d ibabuṛen, uɣalen d wid yesɛan lqaɛa tameqqrant, ṭṭfent tineɣlafin akk, zedɣent deg ixxamen ssɛayanin, di Cap Bon neɣ deg lḥara n Mégara (Bessis).
society.groups.1.d: Usan-d seg Imeqqranen, sdukklen agraw yettwasbedden mliḥ. Ixxamen n ssjada, imukan n tussna, ḥerzen seg waṭas n leqrun tutlayt d yidles afiniqi, armi d ddaw n Ṛuma. Yiwen uzru n usekkil n tofet (lqern wis 3, Amuzgan n Bardo) isban-d lkahen s ubernus n lkettan, aqerruy-is yettwaḥlaqen ddaw n ṭṭaqiya.
society.groups.2.d: Imesnaɛen d imettjaren, s uɛdad ur yettwassen ara ; irgazen ilelliyen d iklan, wiyi d wayla n yiwen umdan neɣ n Temdint ; akked ibeṛṛaniyen i d-yusan seg akk Lebḥer Alemmas (Dridi). Tira n zik ur asen-tefka ara awal ur-iyi kra tikwal.

women.title: Tilawin, gar Tazmert ɣef Yiman d Tdukla
women.paras.0: Didon, Sophonisbe, tameṭṭut n Hasdrubal i yefran tamettant di 146 : kra n timucuha ibanen, maca drus n tɣbula. Tametti d tabaḍnit, maca tefka i tilawin tazmert ɣef yiman n tidet : kra n yiẓra n usekkil n tofet ttwafkan sɣur tilawin s yisem-nsent, aṭas n lmihen ldin i-tent, tawuri n lkahnin daɣen ur tt-tent-tegg ara (Dridi).
women.paras.1: Zzwaǧ yeqqim d lsas asertan. Sophonisbe, yelli-s n uqayed Hasdrubal mmi-s n Giscon, tezweǧ agellid anumidi Syphax akken ad tseddukel tadukla, syen Massinissa. Ur yettwassen ara ma tella poligamit.
libyans.title: Ilibiyen : ddaw adabu, maca yal tikkelt ilaqen
libyans.paras.0: Imezdaɣ izuranen d wid ur yettwassen ara mliḥ. Ttjara n zik tuɣal d adabu : deg umennuɣ apunik amezwaru, Qarṭaǧ tettekk azgen n timegriwin n lexla (Polybe, I, 72), tagrawla tettuɣal-d yal tikkelt — di 240, Ilibiyen ddan s tegrawla ɣer umennuɣ n Yimirsinariyen.
libyans.paras.1: Maca tiddukla qeṛbent : imeqqranen ipunikiyen zweǧen tiḥerɛatin tilibiyin (Bessis), kra n iẓekwan sdukklen lɛadat tifiniqiyin d tilibiyin, tiddukla tipunikiyen llant d tiɣersiwin seg tazwara-nsent. Deg lqern wis 2, iɣurar n Massinissa gan amur deg uɣelluy n temdint.

related.1.title: Ssɛaya Tugar i Ṛuma
related.1.text: Acuɣer ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ, ugar n lsilaḥ-ines, tesserɣ ul n Ṛuma.
related.2.title: Tadamsa Tapunikt
related.2.text: Ibeḥriyen, iberdan n lfeṣṣa, tafellaḥt : lsas n ssɛaya n yimeqqranen.
